$ git checkout 4124bba373813f00a78d9aae54171c7116016802
$ while true; do python3.9 ./long_system_test.py --nodes=127.0.0.1:5433,127.0.0.2:5433,127.0.0.3:5433 --threads=10 --runtime=60 --max-columns=15 --complexity=full; sleep 10; done
